POL

1 1.4 Consolidated-
Behavioural Competency
Assessment for Officers

and Engineers ;.

Note

e Rate each element as per this rating:

1- Poor/ Unsatisfactory;

2- Fair/ Needs Improvement;

3- Good/ Meets Expectation;

4- Very Good/ Exceeds Expectation;
5- Outstanding/ Exceptional

If the competency is not assessed or is not applicable, choose the
option "Not Applicable/ Did not assess"

Enter the final average score for each behavioural competency under
individual section after assessing all the elements in each domain.
You may choose to assess at least one or more than one competency
on the task, activity or operation being assessed.

Refer to the scores from this assessment when updating the e-
apprasial of seafarers on COMPAS.
